description: This file is a shell script that contains test cases for Git's email configuration and commit behavior. It sets up various scenarios to ensure that email settings and author/committer identities work correctly in different contexts.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets Git configuration variables for testing.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the repository for testing purposes.

methods.name: sane_unset
methods.description: Unsets environment variables or configs for clean state.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Schedules commands to run after a test case.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of test cases.
